description: Presmium decks in VS Code: diagnostics, anchor navigation and completion from the Presmium language server, and a presmium dev preview that follows the cursor
configuration.title: Presmium
configuration.server.runtime: Node.js executable that runs the language server (Node.js 22.19 or later).
configuration.server.path: Path to presmium-language-server.mjs. By default the one of @lincyaw/language-server installed in the workspace, else the extension's own.
